name: sort
summary: Sorts the lines of a text.
description: Sorts the lines of files (or of standard input) and prints the result. The sort is alphabetical by default and depends on the system language; LC_ALL=C sort gives a byte-by-byte sort, faster and predictable.

options.description: Numeric sort: 10 comes after 9, not after 1.
Numeric sort that understands units (2K, 1G), handy with du -h.
Sorts by a field: -k2 for the 2nd column, -k2,2n for a numeric sort limited to that column.
Writes the result to a file (can be the input file).
Only checks whether the input is already sorted.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) to sort. Without a file: standard input.

examples.explanation: Sorts numbers from largest to smallest.
Sorts a CSV by its 3rd column, numerically.
The 5 largest entries in the current directory.
Counts the occurrences of each line (uniq needs sorted input).
